nodes.title: Advanced Nonvolatile Memory Physics
nodes.titleZh: 先进非易失存储器物理
nodes.excerpt: Nonvolatile memories differ by the state variable that crosses an energy barrier during write and remains trapped during retention: charge, polarization, atomic configuration, phase or magnetization.

nodes.title: Artificial Synapses and Neuromorphic Dynamics
nodes.titleZh: 人工突触与神经形态动力学
nodes.excerpt: A physical synapse maps pulse history to conductance, while dynamical memristors can use relaxation, thresholds and volatility to emulate short- and long-term plasticity or neuronal dynamics.

nodes.title: Ballistic and Quasi-Ballistic Transport
nodes.titleZh: 弹道与准弹道输运
nodes.excerpt: Transport becomes ballistic when device length is shorter than the relevant momentum-relaxation mean free path; quasi-ballistic devices retain only part of the injected flux.

nodes.title: Berry Curvature and Topological Transport
nodes.titleZh: 贝里曲率与拓扑输运
nodes.excerpt: Berry curvature acts as a momentum-space magnetic field, producing anomalous transverse velocity and connecting local band geometry to global topological invariants.

nodes.title: The Bipolar Junction Transistor: Minority-Carrier Injection and Gain
nodes.titleZh: 双极晶体管：少子注入与电流放大
nodes.excerpt: The BJT as two asymmetric coupled PN junctions, combining emitter injection, thin-base transport, and collector-field collection.

nodes.title: 黑体辐射与普朗克公式：从腔模计数到量子化
nodes.excerpt: 从热辐射的历史危机出发，逐步推导普朗克黑体谱，并由此得到维恩位移律与斯特藩–玻尔兹曼定律。

nodes.title: Charge-Trap Flash and Three-Dimensional NAND
nodes.titleZh: 电荷俘获型 Flash 与三维 NAND
nodes.excerpt: Charge-trap cells store carriers in localized dielectric states rather than one continuous floating gate; vertical strings trade lithographic scaling for layer stacking.

nodes.title: Cold Cathodes and Two-Dimensional Electron Emitters
nodes.titleZh: 冷阴极与二维电子发射器
nodes.excerpt: A cold cathode emits electrons into vacuum without thermionic heating, commonly through field emission from a high-field nanoscale edge or tip.

nodes.title: Cold-Source Field-Effect Transistor
nodes.titleZh: 冷源场效应晶体管
nodes.excerpt: A cold-source FET suppresses the high-energy tail of injected carriers through a sharply decreasing source density of states or an energy-selective heterojunction.

nodes.title: Compute-in-Memory
nodes.titleZh: 存内计算
nodes.excerpt: Compute-in-memory performs operations where data are stored, commonly using Kirchhoff current summation and Ohm conductance multiplication in crossbars.

nodes.title: Crossbar Arrays, Selectors and Sneak Paths
nodes.titleZh: 交叉阵列、选通器与潜通路
nodes.excerpt: A crossbar maps conductance cells to row–column intersections, but unselected paths carry parasitic current unless nonlinearity or access devices isolate them.

nodes.title: Breakdown, Scaling, and Device Nonidealities
nodes.titleZh: 击穿、缩放与器件非理想效应
nodes.excerpt: Tunneling, avalanche, short-channel electrostatics, high-field transport, parasitics, self-heating, and reliability across PN junctions, BJTs, and MOSFETs.

nodes.title: Dirac Fermions in Two-Dimensional Materials
nodes.titleZh: 二维材料中的狄拉克费米子
nodes.excerpt: In graphene-like systems two sublattices produce a low-energy pseudospin Hamiltonian with approximately linear dispersion and chiral wavefunctions.

nodes.title: Emerging Steep-Slope Transistors
nodes.titleZh: 新兴陡峭亚阈值晶体管
nodes.excerpt: Steep-slope concepts try to reduce switching voltage by changing injection statistics, adding internal voltage gain or reshaping the source density of states.

nodes.title: Excitonic and Single-Photon Devices
nodes.titleZh: 激子与单光子器件
nodes.excerpt: Localized excitons in defects, strain potentials or moiré cells can emit one photon at a time, while interlayer excitons provide electrically tunable dipoles and transport.

nodes.title: Excitons in Two-Dimensional Semiconductors
nodes.titleZh: 二维半导体中的激子
nodes.excerpt: Reduced screening and quantum confinement bind electrons and holes strongly, so excitons, trions and many-body renormalization dominate optical spectra of monolayer TMDs.

nodes.title: Ferroelectric Field-Effect Transistor Memory
nodes.titleZh: 铁电场效应晶体管存储器
nodes.excerpt: A FeFET stores remanent polarization in its gate stack; the polarization charge shifts channel threshold and can be read nondestructively as conductance.

nodes.title: Flash Injection, Program and Erase Physics
nodes.titleZh: Flash 注入、编程与擦除物理
nodes.excerpt: Flash changes stored charge through channel hot-electron injection, Fowler–Nordheim tunneling or related high-field transport, then reads the resulting threshold shift at low bias.

nodes.title: Floating-Gate MOS Memory
nodes.titleZh: 浮栅 MOS 存储器
nodes.excerpt: An electrically isolated conductor stores electronic charge and shifts the threshold voltage through a capacitive divider.

nodes.title: Functional and Neuromorphic Devices
nodes.titleZh: 功能与神经形态器件
nodes.excerpt: Functional devices exploit internal dynamics, nonvolatility, optical response or stochasticity so that one physical element performs memory, sensing or computation rather than only binary switching.

nodes.title: Graphene and van der Waals Josephson Devices
nodes.titleZh: 石墨烯与范德华约瑟夫森器件
nodes.excerpt: Superconducting electrodes induce pair correlations in a 2D weak link; gates tune carrier density, transmission and the current–phase relation.

nodes.title: Graphene Electron-Optics Devices
nodes.titleZh: 石墨烯电子光学器件
nodes.excerpt: Ballistic Dirac carriers refract at gate-defined p–n interfaces and can be collimated or focused when phase coherence and mean free path exceed device dimensions.

nodes.title: Heterojunctions, JFETs, MESFETs, and HEMTs
nodes.titleZh: 异质结、JFET、MESFET与HEMT
nodes.excerpt: A unified view of JFETs, MESFETs, MODFETs/HEMTs, and two-dimensional carrier gases through depletion control and heterojunction band engineering.

nodes.title: Hydrodynamic Electron Flow
nodes.titleZh: 电子流体动力学
nodes.excerpt: When momentum-conserving electron–electron collisions are faster than momentum-relaxing scattering, carriers behave collectively as a viscous charged fluid.

nodes.title: Interface Dipoles and Fermi-Level Pinning in 2D Contacts
nodes.titleZh: 二维接触中的界面偶极与费米能级钉扎
nodes.excerpt: A metal–2D semiconductor contact is set by work functions, interface dipoles, metal-induced gap states, defects and local electrostatics rather than by the ideal Schottky–Mott rule alone.

nodes.title: Interlayer and Moiré Excitons
nodes.titleZh: 层间激子与莫尔激子
nodes.excerpt: In a type-II vdW heterostructure the electron and hole can occupy different layers; the resulting dipole lengthens lifetime and makes the exciton sensitive to gate field, twist and moiré confinement.

nodes.title: Interlayer Tunneling and Negative Differential Resistance
nodes.titleZh: 层间隧穿与负微分电阻
nodes.excerpt: Atomically sharp vdW interfaces allow tunneling between two separately gated layers; energy and in-plane momentum alignment can create a resonant current peak followed by negative differential resistance.

nodes.title: Klein Tunneling and Electron Optics
nodes.titleZh: 克莱因隧穿与电子光学
nodes.excerpt: Chiral Dirac carriers can transmit perfectly at normal incidence through a smooth electrostatic barrier because pseudospin matching suppresses backscattering.

nodes.title: Knowledge Atlas
nodes.excerpt: A living map connecting published articles with smaller, evolving research notes.

nodes.title: Landauer–Büttiker Quantum Transport
nodes.titleZh: Landauer–Büttiker 量子输运
nodes.excerpt: Mesoscopic current is carried by quantum modes whose occupations are fixed by reservoirs and whose contribution is weighted by transmission.

nodes.title: Magnetic Random-Access Memory
nodes.titleZh: 磁阻随机存储器
nodes.excerpt: MRAM stores the relative magnetization of magnetic layers and reads it through tunneling magnetoresistance.

nodes.title: Memory Reliability, Variability and Scaling
nodes.titleZh: 存储器可靠性、变异与缩放
nodes.excerpt: Retention, endurance, read/write disturb, stochastic variation and thermal stability are coupled consequences of the energy landscape and write stress.

nodes.title: Memristive Systems and Resistive Switching
nodes.titleZh: 忆阻系统与阻变物理
nodes.excerpt: A memristive system has conductance controlled by internal state variables with their own dynamics; physical implementations include ionic redox, phase, ferroelectric and spin configurations.

nodes.title: Metal–Semiconductor Contacts and Schottky Barriers
nodes.titleZh: 金属-半导体接触与肖特基势垒
nodes.excerpt: Schottky and ohmic contacts from work-function alignment, electron affinity, thermionic emission, tunneling, and Fermi-level pinning.

nodes.title: Moiré Quantum Matter and Correlated Flat Bands
nodes.titleZh: 莫尔量子物质与关联平带
nodes.excerpt: A small twist angle or lattice mismatch produces a long-period moiré potential that narrows bands and makes Coulomb interactions comparable to or larger than kinetic energy.

nodes.title: The MOS Capacitor: Accumulation, Depletion, and Inversion
nodes.titleZh: MOS电容：积累、耗尽与反型
nodes.excerpt: Accumulation, depletion, inversion, threshold, and C–V response from gate-voltage partitioning, surface potential, and semiconductor space charge.

nodes.title: The MOSFET: Gate-Controlled Charge and Channel Transport
nodes.titleZh: MOSFET：栅控电荷与沟道输运
nodes.excerpt: Combining vertical MOS electrostatics with lateral source–drain transport to derive long-channel I–V, transconductance, saturation, and subthreshold behavior.

nodes.title: Negative-Capacitance Field-Effect Transistor
nodes.titleZh: 负电容场效应晶体管
nodes.excerpt: An NC-FET places a ferroelectric response in the gate stack so that a change in gate voltage may produce a larger change in semiconductor surface potential.

nodes.title: Nonequilibrium Carriers: Generation, Recombination, and Quasi-Fermi Levels
nodes.titleZh: 非平衡载流子：产生、复合与准费米能级
nodes.excerpt: Carrier lifetime, diffusion length, generation–recombination mechanisms, and electron–hole quasi-Fermi-level splitting under optical or electrical injection.

nodes.title: Device Physics of Nonvolatile Memory
nodes.titleZh: 非易失存储器的器件物理
nodes.excerpt: Flash and EEPROM operation from floating-gate-induced threshold shifts, including program, erase, read, retention, and endurance trade-offs.

nodes.title: Optoelectronic Memory, Photomemristors and Reconfigurable Devices
nodes.titleZh: 光电存储、光忆阻与可重构器件
nodes.excerpt: Coupling photogeneration to trapped charge, ions, polarization or phase creates devices whose conductance remembers illumination and can combine sensing, memory and processing.

nodes.title: Optoelectronic Devices: LEDs, Photodiodes, and Solar Cells
nodes.titleZh: 光电子器件：LED、光电二极管与太阳电池
nodes.excerpt: A unified account of light emission, detection, and photovoltaics through absorption, generation–recombination, junction separation, and quasi-Fermi-level splitting.

nodes.title: Phase-Change Memory
nodes.titleZh: 相变存储器
nodes.excerpt: PCM stores information in the resistance contrast between amorphous and crystalline phases produced by controlled Joule-heating pulses.

nodes.title: The PN Junction: Space Charge, Band Bending, and Rectification
nodes.titleZh: PN结：空间电荷、能带与整流
nodes.excerpt: From diffusion-built space charge and built-in potential to the diode equation, junction capacitance, transients, and breakdown.

nodes.title: Power Semiconductor Devices
nodes.titleZh: 功率半导体器件
nodes.excerpt: Power diodes, MOSFETs, IGBTs, and thyristors through the trade-offs among blocking voltage, conduction loss, switching loss, and heat removal.

nodes.title: Quantum Capacitance in Two-Dimensional Devices
nodes.titleZh: 二维器件中的量子电容
nodes.excerpt: When the electronic density of states is small, adding charge must move the chemical potential; this finite electronic compressibility appears as a capacitance in series with the geometrical gate capacitance.

nodes.title: Quantum Dots, Spin–Valley Qubits and Topological Candidates
nodes.titleZh: 量子点、自旋–谷量子比特与拓扑候选器件
nodes.excerpt: Electrostatic confinement discretizes 2D electronic states; spin, valley, layer or parity can encode quantum information and couple to gates, resonators or superconductors.

nodes.title: Quantum Hall and Topological Edge States
nodes.titleZh: 量子霍尔与拓扑边缘态
nodes.excerpt: Landau quantization or nontrivial band topology can create bulk gaps with conducting boundary channels protected against selected scattering processes.

nodes.title: Quantum Tunneling in Semiconductor Devices
nodes.titleZh: 半导体器件中的量子隧穿
nodes.excerpt: A carrier can cross a classically forbidden barrier when its wavefunction has finite amplitude on the far side; barrier shape, effective mass and conserved momentum set the transmission.

nodes.title: Reduced Dielectric Screening in Two Dimensions
nodes.titleZh: 二维体系中的弱介电屏蔽
nodes.excerpt: Field lines around an atomically thin layer extend into its environment, so electron–electron and electron–hole interactions are nonlocal and strongly substrate dependent.

nodes.title: Resistive RAM and Conductive-Filament Dynamics
nodes.titleZh: 阻变存储器与导电细丝动力学
nodes.excerpt: RRAM switches resistance by redistributing ions and defects, often forming or rupturing a nanoscale metallic or oxygen-vacancy-rich conduction path.

nodes.title: Resonant and Interlayer Tunneling Devices
nodes.titleZh: 共振与层间隧穿器件
nodes.excerpt: Separate 2D electrodes and barriers create spectrally and momentum-selective current, with gates tuning alignment rather than only barrier height.

nodes.title: Energy Bands, Density of States, and Carrier Statistics
nodes.titleZh: 能带、态密度与载流子统计
nodes.excerpt: From bands in a periodic potential to electron and hole concentrations through density of states, Fermi statistics, and charge neutrality.

nodes.title: Drift, Diffusion, and Current in Semiconductors
nodes.titleZh: 半导体中的漂移、扩散与电流
nodes.excerpt: A unified account of drift and diffusion through electric fields, concentration gradients, and electrochemical potentials, including their high-field limits.

nodes.title: The Governing Equations of Semiconductor Devices
nodes.titleZh: 半导体器件的基本方程
nodes.excerpt: The self-consistent Poisson, carrier-statistics, drift–diffusion, and continuity system underlying classical semiconductor-device simulation.

nodes.title: Semiconductor Device Physics Knowledge Network: From Energy Bands to Device Functions
nodes.titleZh: 半导体器件物理知识网络：从能带到器件功能
nodes.excerpt: A causal map of semiconductor device physics, organized around physical dependencies rather than textbook page order and scoped to Sze's third edition.

nodes.title: Sliding-Ferroelectric Memory Devices
nodes.titleZh: 滑移铁电存储器件
nodes.excerpt: In a vdW bilayer, electrically driven relative translation changes stacking order and reverses an out-of-plane dipole, creating a structural polarization state.

nodes.title: Spin and Valley Devices
nodes.titleZh: 自旋与谷器件
nodes.excerpt: Spin and valley devices generate, manipulate and detect internal quantum labels through optical helicity, magnetic proximity, spin–orbit fields or Berry-curvature-driven transverse motion.

nodes.title: Spin–Valley Physics in Two-Dimensional Semiconductors
nodes.titleZh: 二维半导体中的自旋–谷物理
nodes.excerpt: Broken inversion symmetry and strong spin–orbit coupling in monolayer TMDs tie spin, valley and optical helicity to the K and K′ band extrema.

nodes.title: Benchmarking Steep-Slope Devices
nodes.titleZh: 陡峭亚阈值器件的基准比较
nodes.excerpt: A credible comparison must place current, slope, capacitance, voltage, delay, energy, area, temperature and hysteresis on the same operating point and footprint.

nodes.title: Subthreshold Swing and the Thermal Limit
nodes.titleZh: 亚阈值摆幅与热力学极限
nodes.excerpt: A conventional MOSFET changes current by electrostatically moving a barrier through a thermally broadened Fermi distribution, producing the familiar room-temperature 60 mV/dec lower bound under ideal quasistatic conditions.

nodes.title: Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor
nodes.titleZh: 隧穿场效应晶体管
nodes.excerpt: A TFET gate controls the spatial overlap of source valence-band states and channel conduction-band states, turning band-to-band tunneling on and off.

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional and Sliding Ferroelectricity
nodes.titleZh: 二维与滑移铁电性
nodes.excerpt: Switchable polarization can survive in atomically thin crystals; in sliding ferroelectrics it arises from stacking-dependent interlayer charge transfer and reverses when layers translate.

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional Magnetic Tunnel Junctions
nodes.titleZh: 二维磁隧道结
nodes.excerpt: Atomically sharp stacks of 2D magnets, semiconductors and insulators create spin-dependent tunneling or spin-filter barriers controlled by magnetic configuration and gates.

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional Magnetism and Spin Filtering
nodes.titleZh: 二维磁性与自旋过滤
nodes.excerpt: Magnetic anisotropy and spin–orbit coupling can stabilize order in atomically thin magnets, while vdW interfaces provide clean spin filters and proximity exchange.

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional Quantum Devices
nodes.titleZh: 二维量子器件
nodes.excerpt: Two-dimensional materials expose every carrier to gates, interfaces and optical fields, allowing quantum states to be assembled and tuned in devices rather than fixed only by bulk chemistry.

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional Quantum Foundations
nodes.titleZh: 二维量子物理基础
nodes.excerpt: Reducing a crystal to one or a few atomic layers changes screening, density of states, symmetry and available internal degrees of freedom; it does more than merely shrink a bulk semiconductor.

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional Superconductivity and Josephson Physics
nodes.titleZh: 二维超导与约瑟夫森物理
nodes.excerpt: Two-dimensional superconductors combine phase fluctuations, strong spin–orbit coupling and gate-tunable carrier density; proximity coupling transfers pairing correlations into graphene or TMD channels.

nodes.title: Two-Dimensional, Heterojunction and Interlayer TFETs
nodes.titleZh: 二维、异质结与层间 TFET
nodes.excerpt: Atomically thin bodies improve gate control, while type-II or broken-gap vdW heterojunctions reduce tunneling distance and permit independent band alignment by dual gates.

nodes.title: Uncertainty as Fourier Reciprocity: From Position–Momentum to Time–Frequency
nodes.titleZh: 不确定性是傅里叶互易性：从位置—动量到时间—频率
nodes.excerpt: Position–momentum and time–frequency uncertainty are two expressions of the same Fourier reciprocity between localization and spectral width.
